breaking.title: Tower of Terror evacuated guests yesterday
breaking.body: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror at Hollywood Studios experienced an evacuation on October 19, requiring guests to exit the attraction. The attraction has since resumed normal operation.

parkioInsight.text: Tower of Terror typically experiences higher wait times after technical issues as guests return. Riding during the first hour or final two hours of park operation usually avoids residual crowds.

breaking.title: Sam's Club discounting Disney gift cards 10% today
breaking.body: Sam's Club is offering a limited-time 10% discount on Disney gift cards, expected to sell out quickly based on past promotions.

parkioInsight.text: Gift card discounts typically vanish within hours of launch. Purchasing early this morning and using for future dining reservations or merchandise often locks in immediate savings.

bignews.title: Veterans Day merchandise collection now available
bignews.body: Disney released its 2026 Veterans Day merchandise collection across Walt Disney World Resort locations, honoring military service members and their families.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition patriotic collections tend to sell out at flagship stores like World of Disney by mid-November. Shopping during weekday mornings usually offers the fullest selection.

bignews.title: Tower of Terror may receive new Twilight Zone content
bignews.body: Disney World appears to be working on a new or expanded Twilight Zone episode for the Tower of Terror attraction at Hollywood Studios, though no official timeline has been announced.

parkioInsight.text: Attraction enhancements often draw heavier crowds once announced. Experiencing Tower of Terror before any formal reveal typically means shorter waits and fewer expectation-driven lines.

bignews.title: Tangled restroom area replacement underway at Magic Kingdom
bignews.body: Magic Kingdom has begun repainting the Tangled-themed restroom facility in Fantasyland, with construction visible to guests. The project timeline has not been disclosed.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise and barriers near Fantasyland restrooms may affect guest flow. Using facilities near Peter Pan or Haunted Mansion usually avoids refurbishment disruptions during peak hours.

topstories.title: New holiday Spirit Jerseys feature Frozen and Nightmare Before Christmas
topstories.body: Disney released five new holiday-themed Spirit Jerseys online, celebrating Frozen, The Nightmare Before Christmas, and a Hallmark-inspired Holiday Ever After design.

parkioInsight.text: Popular Spirit Jersey designs often arrive in parks 7–10 days after online launch. Ordering now typically secures sizes before in-park stock arrives and sells through quickly.

topstories.title: D23 reveals fall Gold Theater watchlist with Ultimate Fan Event panels
topstories.body: D23 announced its October and November Gold Theater streaming schedule, featuring panels from The Ultimate Disney Fan Event 2026 held earlier this year.

parkioInsight.text: Watching D23 panels before visiting often surfaces upcoming park announcements and merchandise launches. Staying current usually helps spot limited-time offerings once you arrive in the parks.

topstories.title: Muppet Christmas Carol collection now available online
topstories.body: Disney Store launched an exclusive Muppet Christmas Carol collection online, including apparel, plush toys, and themed accessories for the holiday season.

parkioInsight.text: Muppet-themed holiday merchandise typically migrates to in-park locations within two weeks. Ordering online now often beats the rush once items appear at World of Disney or park shops.

topstories.title: Winnie the Pooh 100th Anniversary products released across parks
topstories.body: Disney launched new Winnie the Pooh merchandise celebrating the character's centennial, available at park locations and online, featuring apparel and collectibles.

parkioInsight.text: Anniversary collections often sell fastest at Magic Kingdom's Hundred Acre Goods and EPCOT's World Traveler. Shopping within the first week usually secures the widest selection before restocks slow.

topstories.title: Grand Floridian closure update issued by Disney World
topstories.body: Walt Disney World provided an update on ongoing closures and refurbishments at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort and Spa, affecting select guest areas.

parkioInsight.text: Resort refurbishments can limit dining and amenity access. Confirming restaurant availability and pool hours before arrival usually prevents surprises on check-in day.

topstories.title: Banana Ball returning to Disney World in 2027
topstories.body: The Savannah Bananas announced Banana Ball games will return to Walt Disney World in 2027, with dates and locations revealed during a live ESPN2 broadcast.

parkioInsight.text: Special sporting events at ESPN Wide World of Sports often draw crowds away from the four main parks. Planning theme park days during Banana Ball weekends may offer lighter attraction queues.

icymi.title: Disney Imagination cruise ship to sail from Japan in 2029
icymi.body: Disney Cruise Line named its first Japan-based ship Disney Imagination, set to depart from Tokyo beginning spring 2029.

icymi.title: Rainbow character head magnets now available at Walt Disney World
icymi.body: New rainbow-colored magnets featuring Mickey, Minnie, Stitch, and Disney Princesses are now sold at select Walt Disney World retail locations.

icymi.title: Hollywood Studios icon receives multi-year replacement project
icymi.body: Disney World confirmed a long-term project to update one of Hollywood Studios' oldest landmarks, originally installed when the park opened in 1989.

spotlight.title: Disney's Halloween offerings peak this week at Disney Springs
spotlight.body: Disney Springs continues its Halloween season programming through October 31, featuring seasonal dining, shopping, and entertainment. New experiences include themed menus and limited-edition merchandise across the complex.

parkioInsight.text: Disney Springs Halloween crowds typically peak on weekends through October 31. Visiting on weekday afternoons before 5pm usually offers easier parking and shorter restaurant waits.
